actual:
Research Assistant chat page 'Phase 7 Evidence / Blockers' panel (frontend/src/app/research-assistant/chat/page.tsx:646) renders Blocker/Evidence cards with two defects. (1) Layout breaks into per-character wrapping: .ra-evidence-ref-grid (research-assistant.css:254, grid-template-columns minmax(96px,0.28fr) 1fr) starves the value column inside the narrow side panel so long text degrades to per-char break; should stack to single column (label above value) at narrow width or fix column sizing. (2) Raw JSON shown on main UI: BlockerCard.tsx and EvidenceCard.tsx render which via AssistantShared.tsx:101 prints the whole card object as 
{JSON.stringify(card,null,2)}
; should remove or collapse behind a developer-details toggle and show human-readable fields in main view. Minor: provenance shows only Object.keys(...).join(', ') (key names), should show source value. NOTE: as_of showing '-' is intended honest behavior, not a bug; do not change it.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
